data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate experienced a small gross prior-year release of approximately GBP 4.6m driven by favourable claims development predominantly in the 2018 and 2019 underwriting years. The accounts also report a net prior year favourable development of GBP 5.1m. The release is concentrated in the Fire (Property) and Reinsurance books (net amounts reported by LOB), while the 2021 result was adversely affected by current-year catastrophe losses (Hurricane Ida, European floods and US Winter Storms) which are separate from the prior-year movements.
raw_causal_phrases: Claims incurred, net of reinsurance, include favourable prior year development of GBP 5.1m (2020: GBP 6.6m).
Prior year claims development is analysed by line of business in the table below.
The Syndicate reports a loss for the year of GBP 12.7m (2020: GBP 10.3m), reflecting catastrophe losses, in particular on Hurricane Ida, European floods and US Winter Storms.
Catastrophe losses during 2021 exceeded the long term average annual allowance for catastrophe losses, however, attritonal loss experience was better than expected.

data.data_quality_notes: Gross prior-year movement was not provided explicitly as a gross 'movement in prior year's provision' figure. Gross PYD was computed from the gross claims development triangle (sum of diagonal changes for underwriting years up to 2019). The report explicitly states a net prior year favourable development (GBP 5.1m) and provides net by-LOB amounts; those net LOB figures were used for LOB movement mapping (hence LOB amounts are net and have lower confidence). No explicit gross-by-LOB prior year movements were available. Triangle appears free of RITC distortion in notes.
